cited.quote: special training will be conducted for students to acquire skill sets as per the requirements of the industry

rationale: C3 mentions industry-linked skill training (Naan Mudhalvan) in a budget speech, but this is a plan, not a guideline on IT firm and higher education tie-ups. No GO or guideline shown.
No extract shows an MoU or partnership between IT firms and universities. C1 (college entrepreneurship cells), C4 (agri university) and C5 (startup mission board) are on other subjects.
No extract mentions a fishing boat manufacturing unit at Kulachal. C2 covers boat subsidies only.
No extract concerns appointing community welfare workers under BDOs. Extracts cover plantation rules, women policy draft, SHGs and AGAMT.
No extract shows any action on pay or job grievances of Khadi Board workers or mosquito control supervisors. C1 only describes the Board's objectives.

cited.quote: Protocol for management of Diabetes in COVID-19 and Management of COVID patients with Co-Morbidities

rationale: C2 is a COVID-era protocol for diabetes management, not a dedicated diabetes and blood pressure wing in government hospitals. No sanction for such wings appears.
No extract concerns stormwater drainage in municipalities. C4 discusses rural drainage guidance only incidentally; C5 lists KNMT works without storm drains.
Extracts show input subsidies and machinery schemes but nothing on delivering inputs to all villages through farmer-friendly vehicles at a fixed support price.

cited.quote: a sum of Rs.85.54 crore was disbursed to 1,71,076 fishermen families of 14 coastal districts

rationale: C2 shows ban-period relief disbursed (Rs.85.54 crore to 1,71,076 families, about Rs.5,000 each) with no increase to Rs.8,000. No GO raising the amount.
The promise refers to 20,000 teachers whom no extract identifies. C1 and C2 are audit observations on college teacher pay; no step on periodic pay is shown.

cited.quote: recent technologies such as Drone, Digital Marketing, Bigdata analysis, smart farming, food processing

rationale: C1 is GO 174 (2021-10-28) approving an entrepreneurship programme for agri students covering technologies like drones and smart farming. It is a single project, not a yearly introduction of farming technologies.

cited.quote: the beneficiaries are given 8 gram gold coin along with cash assistance of Rs.25,000/-

rationale: C2 shows only the existing inter-caste scheme with 8 gram gold and Rs.25,000 or Rs.50,000. No special assistance of Rs.60,000 for ST partners is shown.
Extracts concern MGNREGS, urban employment scheme and school sanitary worker payments; none is a step on employment, salary or pension for local body sanitary workers.

cited.quote: advise the Government of Sri Lanka to ensure that Eelam Tamils have equal civil and political rights

rationale: C1 (Governor's address) only states the government will urge the Union to advise Sri Lanka on equal rights; this is intent, with no referendum advice or formal step shown.

cited.quote: the construction work has been completed by Public Works Department and put in to use by public

rationale: C3 notes Anna Centenary Library construction was completed and is in public use; no renovation or upgrade order or sanction appears.

cited.quote: Providing skill development training in dairying to the employees and milk producers of Dairy Co-operative Societies

rationale: C1 lists skill training in dairying as a strategy in a policy note, not a dedicated workshop series on professional management for dairy cooperatives.
Extracts cover fireworks factory safety rules and plastic bans; nothing on banning sale of imported fireworks.

cited.quote: Food charges are sanctioned at the rate of Rs.1,000 per month for school hostel boarders

rationale: C2 shows current food charges (Rs.1,000 and Rs.1,100 monthly) with no periodic revision linked to inflation. C1 budget doubles a miscellaneous allowance only.

cited.quote: Preparation of feasibility study report (FSR) for establishing MRTS in Madurai, Salem, Trichy and Tirunelveli

rationale: C1 is GO 156 of 2021-08-09 permitting CMRL to prepare a feasibility study report for MRTS in the four cities. It is a preparatory step; no system is operational.

cited.quote: make necessary laws and amendments to grant Indian citizenship to Tamil refugees from Sri Lanka

rationale: C2 states intent to urge the Union on citizenship for Sri Lankan Tamil refugees; C1 shows an advisory committee. No formal step urging inclusion of Sri Lanka in the 2019 amendment is shown.
